meta.title: Bitwise Calculator - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Perform bitwise AND, OR, XOR, NOT, left shift, and right shift operations.
booleanExpressionHint: Use TRUE/FALSE/0/1 with AND, OR, XOR, NOT, parentheses
baseConvertLive: Type in any field to convert live.
steps_bitwise-calculator_1Desc: Type two numbers in decimal, hex (0x prefix), or binary (0b prefix). Both values are shown in all three representations for verification.
steps_bitwise-calculator_2Desc: Select AND (&), OR (|), XOR (^), NOT (~), left shift (<<), or right shift (>>). Results update instantly in decimal, hex, and binary.
steps_bitwise-calculator_3Desc: Click any output format to copy it. Essential for low-level programming, embedded systems, flag manipulation, and performance optimization.
